prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your home’s neighborhood, price range, and what you value in a sale. Based on the available directory results, **Tim McGuire’s team at Compass** is one candidate to interview: it reports 70 team sales in the past 12 months and 628 sales in Pleasanton. **Doug Buenz’s 680 Group** is another, with 28 team sales in the past 12 months and 569 in Pleasanton. Those are team figures, not necessarily the individual agent’s seller-side results.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents and ask each for:
- Recent **seller-represented** sales near your home, at a similar price point
- Their pricing strategy and comparable-sale analysis
- A written marketing plan and who will handle showings and negotiations
- Their proposed commission and contract terms

You can compare the agents’ profiles here: [Tim McGuire](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/pleasanton-ca/) and [Doug Buenz](https://www.zillow.com/profile/DougBuenz). I’d choose the agent who can clearly explain a realistic pricing plan and show strong, recent results with homes like yours—not simply the one with the most sales.
